files.* (and to a lesser extent context.*, arch.*) were used as scratch space, not seeds. Pattern: agent writes a key, refines it, writes again — same key reverie_set 4-7× per session. Worst observed: files.font_awesome_content_view rewritten 7× in session 4fc5ce9a; files.icon_search_view 6× in 8b648fbf. This was the mechanism behind the ~10:1 write:read skew on files.* (123 writes / 9 reads in 16 sessions). Each rewrite was mostly identical content with small deltas — pure noise from the store's perspective.

GUARD SHIPPED in v1.14 (#101, PR #108): tracks per-session-per-key write timestamps in memory. On the 3rd+ write within a 30-min sliding window, reverie_set response gains a "warning:" line naming count + time-since-first-write + pointer to conventions.seedDensity. Telemetry/audit rows gain writeAmpWarning + writeAmpCount. MCP-only — CLI sessions are per-process and have no multi-call session for the guard to attach to. Disciplined stores (kh734385/CAS_robot, m02 audit) cap at 2× — pattern is agent-discipline-specific, not store-specific.
